_comment: zh_TW translation of the solenne_side table, keyed by the English text.

strings.Beat Factor Lusk in his strongroom, then: 在金庫裡擊敗代理人Lusk，然後回去找Bex。
strings.Corin Lusk, heir of the Brass Veil, want: 黃銅帷幕的繼承人Corin Lusk想買下你的隊伍。擊敗他三次。
strings.Old Mags wants the eight brass seals the: 老Mags想要帷幕釘在Ochrewell各處的八枚黃銅印。她要把它們熔成勺子。
strings.Qadir wants the five worst IOUs of Ochre: Qadir想要Ochrewell最糟的五張欠條來生篝火。
strings.The Brass Veil keeps a cistern under its: 黃銅帷幕在Ochrewell的賬房底下有個蓄水池。查清它在數什麼。
strings.The Veil keeps its orders in the lowest: 帷幕把命令存放在蓄水池最底層的房間。讀一讀命令簿。
strings.The Veil prepaid three graves with Under: 帷幕在殯儀師Bex那裡預付了三座墳墓。查清是給誰的。
strings.The last valve turns, the cistern drains: 最後一個閥門轉動，蓄水池排空，樓梯暢通了！
strings.The pipes gurgle along happily. The stai: 管道歡快地咕嚕作響。樓梯保持乾燥。
strings.The valve screams, and every pipe slams: 閥門尖叫一聲，所有管道又砰地關上了。重新開始。
strings.The valve squeals round. Somewhere, wate: 閥門吱吱地轉動。某處的水換了主人。
三塊無禮的墓碑，已全額付清。
strings.You know whose graves they are. Tell Bex: 你知道那是誰的墳了。告訴Bex。
